about.title: About Me
about.intro: Results-driven professional at the intersection of operations, technology, and strategy — bridging teams, building tools, and removing the repetitive work that slows businesses down. From coordinating tree-planting programs across Indonesia to shipping Android apps, I work toward one outcome: measurable, lasting impact. Adaptable across startups, international NGOs, and government institutions, I connect hands-on domain expertise with emerging technology.
about.subtitle: Who I Am
about.body: I'm a results-driven professional who lives where operations, technology, and strategy meet. My career has been about bridging teams, building tools, and eliminating the repetitive work that quietly slows a business down — from automating data requests with Python scripts to digitizing reporting workflows that used to live in spreadsheets. Whether I'm coordinating tree-planting programs across Indonesia or shipping an Android app, I aim for the same outcome: measurable, lasting impact. I've worked across startups, international NGOs, and government institutions, and every role has deepened my ability to adapt fast and communicate across cultures. I believe the future belongs to people who connect real domain expertise with emerging technology — and I'm committed to being at that frontier. I'm currently open to new roles and collaborations: if you're looking for someone who will make your team measurably more productive, I'd love to talk.
experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: My Professional Journey
exp.0.desc: Own customer success end-to-end for TREEO: run field visits to understand partner needs, manage daily activity on the TREEO cloud, shape the UI/UX of the apps, and train partners with documentation they actually use.
exp.1.desc: Ran daily operations across five Tree Planting Partners: planned and tracked planting programs, served as the single point of contact, and guarded data quality and reporting.
exp.2.desc: Grew partner relationships and trust: ran field visits to test real-world UX, coordinated with the global Technology team, and delivered training that partners keep coming back to.
exp.3.desc: My first technical customer role: assessed TREEO's user experience in the field, monitored daily activity on the cloud, improved the apps' UI/UX, and gave hands-on support and training.
exp.4.desc: Shipped Android apps built with Kotlin and Java in Android Studio. Designed wireframes and high-fidelity mockups for mobile and web, and worked side-by-side with stakeholders to turn business requirements into intuitive user interfaces.
exp.5.desc: Prepared data-flow and safety materials, ran data collection and processing, and kept new safety procedures consistent across every team member.
exp.6.desc: Owned office operations: contracts, asset handovers, security and driver coordination, a four-vehicle fleet, and full asset tracking across the company.
exp.7.desc: Rode B2B communication end-to-end, demonstrating the Quick Tractor product to oil palm plantations across Sumatra, Sulawesi, and Borneo.
exp.8.desc: Designed the cover of the annual census publication and produced the posters and vector graphics that supported its release.
